# Trim 

```{r}
# Load built-in dataset
data(mtcars)

# Basic scatter plot: Miles per gallon vs. Horsepower
plot(mtcars$hp, mtcars$mpg,
     main = "MPG vs Horsepower",
     xlab = "Horsepower",
     ylab = "Miles Per Gallon",
     pch = 19,         # Solid circle
     col = "blue")     # Point color
```

# plotly

```{r}
library(plotly)

## Interactive Plot with Plotly

library(plotly)

plot_ly(data = mtcars,
        x = ~hp,
        y = ~mpg,
        type = 'scatter',
        mode = 'markers',
        marker = list(color = 'blue')) %>%
  layout(title = "MPG vs Horsepower",
         xaxis = list(title = "Horsepower"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Miles Per Gallon"))
```



# 3d 

```{r}


plot_ly(data = mtcars, 
        x = ~hp, 
        y = ~mpg, 
        z = ~wt, 
        type = "scatter3d", 
        mode = "markers",
        marker = list(size = 5, color = 'orange')) %>%
  layout(title = "3D Scatter: HP vs MPG vs Weight")


```


# raster

```{r}

# Create a matrix (like a 3D raster or elevation map)
z <- volcano  # built-in elevation matrix in R

# 3D surface plot
plot_ly(z = ~z, type = "surface") %>%
  layout(title = "3D Surface Plot of Volcano Data")
```
